 Date : 7th October 2025

P.C. :
This is the second consecutive date when the appellants are not represented through their learned counsel.
2. The appellant no.1 is the father of the appellant no.2-victim.

By the judgment dated 2nd August 2022 passed in Sessions Case No.41 of 2013, the respondent no.2, namely, Imran aka Israt Riyaz Khan was acquitted of the charge framed against him under sections 366, 376 and 307 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. In the aforesaid background, Ms. Yugandhara Khanwilkar, advocate is appointed as Amicus Curiae to argue this Criminal Appeal on behalf of the appellants.
Registry to supply a complete set of paper-book and other documents to the learned Amicus Curiae.
4. For preliminary hearing, post this matter on 4 th November 2025.
